g_policy.reason: Declining leaves the app worse than before the offer: the fourth article was free and readable, and after the X it stays locked until midnight (see 'if the user declines').

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes of unlocked articles (feature_time), which is not cash and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event, the reader opening a fourth article today. No chat or typed content is involved.

g_no_free_removal.reason: 'adds' says articles now lock after the third one each day. That caps free reading, and articles are not a resource that costs the app money per use (unlike model replies or queue priority).

g_brand_safety.reason: The offer is a lock panel opened by an app event over s02 Article, which is rated safe and is not a chat screen. It is not in a message list or next to unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product_change, the new resource is reading time that the player uses in f01 (Read a story), a core flow the model observed. The player keeps all of it.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field states as fact that 'The app has no paywall, limit, or currency.' The model only records that none was seen on the home feed (open question), so the proposal needed 'not seen' wording.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The product model shows no paid plan, so no paying users are targeted or given something their plan already includes.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 30 minutes and the model shows no subscription. It takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The panel appears when a locked item is just tapped (the fourth article opens locked), which is a moment of need under the proposal's own design.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn rewarded game. The articles unlock only 'once the play is confirmed', and the trigger is a detectable article-open count.

c7_specific.reason: It names the home feed story card (s01.e59), the article reader (s02.e04), and a per-day article count, all specific to this news app.

other_concern: The 30-minute window and the cap of 2 per day are invented numbers. The daily limit is itself a new paywall-like gate that may hurt reading engagement and the existing Taboola ad slots.
